propositions: Seven pytest fixtures return complete copies of os.environ directly or nested, exposing arbitrary ambient credentials in pytest long traceback output when fixtures are rendered as test arguments.
Pytest saferepr serializes fixture return values on assertion failures; complete os.environ copies in fixture-decorated functions allow inherited secrets to appear in tracebacks.

All seven affected fixtures can be repaired by replacing dict(os.environ) with explicit allowlisted mappings containing only required keys (fake-bin-first PATH, state directories, timeouts, log paths) while remaining mutable for per-test overrides.
Minimal parent environment tests (env -i PATH=/usr/bin:/bin) pass all affected fixture consumers, proving no behavioral dependency on arbitrary ambient keys.
Long traceback rendering leaks synthetic sentinel values inserted first in os.environ copies from all seven fixtures; short traceback mode does not render them.
